digest.component_or_area: Jira adapter test suite (Cloud vs Data Center)
propositions: Cloud and Data Center Jira adapters lack symmetric test coverage for shared behaviors, with Cloud missing pagination and rate-limiting edge cases while DC lacks byte-for-byte field value pinning and comment length convergence proofs
The ticket-type map is duplicated across adapters/jira/ and must be single-sourced and guarded to prevent regressions in either adapter's create path
DC's field sanitizer boundaries, identity label forms, and probe branches have never been pinned by value despite years of production Cloud incidents producing byte-for-byte characterization pins

DC comment and description length convergence must be tested across multiple passes with oversized inputs, and the comment ceiling constant must cite its provenance (jira.text.field.character.limit and JRASERVER-28519)
Vacuous contract tests that assert only shape rather than values must either be rewritten to assert their named contract or be renamed to reflect what they actually pin
